records.question: 今年每个季度的GMV分别是多少？
keywords: 今年每个季度的GMV分别是多少？
records.first_sql:
SELECT 
  d.quarter AS 季度,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS GMV
FROM 
  fact_order f
JOIN 
  dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE 
  d.year = 2025 
  AND f.order_status != '已取消'
GROUP BY 
  d.quarter
ORDER BY 
  CASE d.quarter 
    WHEN 'Q1' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Q2' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Q3' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'Q4' THEN 4 
  END;
records.final_sql:
SELECT 
  d.quarter AS 季度,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS GMV
FROM 
  fact_order f
JOIN 
  dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE 
  d.year = 2025

GROUP BY

ORDER BY 
  CASE d.quarter 
    WHEN 'Q1' THEN 1

records.question: 2025年的GMV同比增长了多少？

FROM fact_order f

WHERE d.year IN (2024, 2025)
  AND f.order_status != '已取消';

records.question: 本月GMV环比上个月增长了多少？
keywords: 本月GMV环比上个月增长了多少？
records.first_sql:
SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN f.pay_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) THEN f.pay_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) THEN f.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `GMV环比增长率`
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE f.order_status != '已取消'
  AND d.date_id >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y%m01')
  AND d.date_id <= LAST_DAY(CURDATE());
